postconditions.description: The output is a list of real numbers representing the expectation values of the search results for each key with one mistake.
The number of expectation values in the output list is equal to the number of search keys k.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, float) for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each expectation value in the output list is a floating-point number.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 10**9 for x in output)
postconditions.description: Each expectation value is a non-negative floating-point number.
